title: Sell Mineral Rights in Towanda, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Towanda, PA
metaDescription: Own mineral rights near Towanda, the Bradford County seat? We buy Marcellus interests directly and pay cash with straightforward closing.
heroLead: Towanda has been the seat of Bradford County government since long before anyone drilled for gas here, and it's also sat at the center of one of the most heavily leased and drilled counties in the entire Marcellus play for the past fifteen years.
intro: Towanda is the Bradford County seat, situated along the Susquehanna River in the middle of one of the most productive dry-gas counties in the Marcellus fairway. The recorder of deeds office here has processed an enormous volume of lease assignments, division orders, and probate filings tied to gas since the boom began in earnest around 2008, and nearly every mineral transaction in the county eventually runs through this courthouse.

That density of activity means Towanda-area families are often more familiar with the mechanics of leasing and royalties than owners in less developed counties, but it also means a lot of older leases here carry post-production deduction terms that have quietly cost families money for years without a second look.

sections.heading: The Advantage of Being Near the County Seat
paragraphs: Because Bradford County's records are centralized in Towanda, confirming a chain of title or resolving an old probate matter tends to move faster here than for families whose land sits far from the courthouse. That's worth using when you're preparing to sell.

sections.heading: What's Actually Being Deducted From Your Check
paragraphs: Under Pennsylvania's Guaranteed Minimum Royalty Act, you're entitled to at least one-eighth of gross value, but gathering, compression, and transportation deductions permitted under many older leases, upheld broadly by Kilmer v. Elexco, can significantly shrink that net number. We review your specific lease language to explain exactly what's happening.

sections.heading: Making a Sale Straightforward
paragraphs: We pull your deed history, confirm your interest against current units and permits, review your statements, and give you a clear cash offer. We handle recording at the courthouse in Towanda directly.

faqs.question: Does being near the county seat make my sale process faster?
faqs.answer: It often speeds up title confirmation since records are centralized here, though overall timing still depends on the complexity of your specific ownership history.

faqs.question: Why does Bradford County see so much sustained gas activity?
faqs.answer: Strong, consistent dry-gas production from operators active here since the early Marcellus boom has kept development steady for well over a decade.

faqs.question: My royalty check seems small compared to reported gas prices. Why?
faqs.answer: Post-production deductions for gathering, compression, and transportation are the most common reason, particularly on leases signed during the early boom years.

faqs.question: Can you help resolve an old probate matter before we sell?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because probate records are also centralized in Towanda, resolving outstanding heirship issues is often more straightforward here than in other counties.
